records.h: BREAKING: SCOTUS orders Michigan to respond in ballot proposal case
records.s: (The Center Square) – A Michigan citizen-only voting ballot proposal that failed to make it on the Nov. 3 ballot is now before U.S. Supreme Court.

records.h: Russia attacks Kyiv again with jet-powered UAVs in evening, sparking fires
records.s: Russian forces attacked Kyiv with jet-powered UAVs on the evening of 1 September, with Ukrainian air defence responding.

records.h: Kwara Assembly sacks two members over defection to PDP
records.s: This development followed a letter from the APC State Chairman, Sunday Fagbemi, addressed to the Speaker of the House, Salihu Yakubu-Danladi, requesting the vacation of the seats in accordance with Section 109 (1g) (2) of the 1999 Constitution.
